FeaturesPage.everythingYouNeedToBuild: Everything you need to build with AI â powered by Tue Tue
FeaturesPage.dropinReplacementForOpenaisChat: Drop-in replacement for OpenAI's chat completions and embeddings endpoints. Use your existing SDKs and libraries â no code changes needed.
FeaturesPage.chooseFromCuratedSelectionOf: Choose from a curated selection of leading open-source and proprietary models â from lightweight 4B models for simple tasks to advanced 70B+ models for complex reasoning.
FeaturesPage.supportForBothRealtimeStreaming: Support for both real-time streaming responses (SSE) and standard non-streaming requests. Streaming delivers partial results as they're generated.
FeaturesPage.generateVectorEmbeddingsForText: Generate vector embeddings for text â ideal for semantic search, clustering, classification, and RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipelines.
FeaturesPage.connectModelsToExternalTools: Connect models to external tools and APIs. Define functions in familiar JSON schema format, and let the model decide when to call them.
FeaturesPage.sendImagesToSupportedModels: Send images to supported models for analysis, description, and understanding. Works with standard base64-encoded or URL-based image inputs.
FeaturesPage.createScopeAndRevokeApi: Create, scope, and revoke API keys from the console. Track last-used timestamps and monitor usage per key.
FeaturesPage.realtimeVisibilityIntoYourToken: Real-time visibility into your token consumption, request volume, and cost â broken down by model, time period, and API key.
FeaturesPage.payOnlyForWhatYou: Pay only for what you use. No hidden fees, no upfront commitments. Pricing is published per-model per-million-tokens.
FeaturesPage.understandYourPlanLimitsAt: Understand your plan limits at a glance. Configure alerts when approaching quota thresholds. Upgrade or scale as you grow.
FeaturesPage.optimizedInferencePipelineWithIntelligen: Optimized inference pipeline with intelligent request routing and caching for sub-second response times on common workloads.
FeaturesPage.modelsOptimizedForVietnameseLanguage: Models optimized for Vietnamese language understanding and generation. Better accuracy, tone, and cultural context than generic English-first models.
FeaturesPage.detailedApiReferenceQuickstartGuides: Detailed API reference, quickstart guides, and code examples in multiple languages (curl, Python, JavaScript, Go).
FeaturesPage.oneclickSetupToConnectOpenclaw: One-click setup to connect OpenClaw agents with Tue Tue API. Generate pre-configured bundles, presets, and provider configs.
FeaturesPage.useAnyOpenaicompatibleSdkPython: Use any OpenAI-compatible SDK (Python, Node.js, Go, Java, etc.) to interact with Tue Tue API. No custom libraries needed.
FeaturesPage.testModelsInteractivelyInYour: Test models interactively in your browser before writing code. Experiment with parameters, system prompts, and model selection.
FeaturesPage.programmaticallyAccessYourBillingData: Programmatically access your billing data, download VAT invoices, and manage subscriptions through dedicated API endpoints.
FeaturesPage.receiveRealtimeNotificationsForUsage: Receive real-time notifications for usage thresholds, billing events, and service status changes via webhooks.
FeaturesPage.yourDataStaysYoursOpt: Your data stays yours. Opt out of training at any time. Enterprise customers are never used for model training by default. Full compliance with Vietnamese data protection laws.
FeaturesPage.endtoendEncryptionInTransitTls: End-to-end encryption in transit (TLS 1.3) and at rest. Industry-standard security practices, regular audits, and incident response procedures.
FeaturesPage.prioritySupportWithSlasFor: Priority support with SLAs for enterprise plans. Direct access to our engineering team for integration assistance and troubleshooting.
FeaturesPage.needDedicatedInfrastructureWeOffer: Need dedicated infrastructure? We offer private deployments with isolated compute, custom model fine-tuning, and on-premise options for qualifying customers.
